Recording your reaction in the mission, verbatim, as the first operator read of the brief.㊢ ("it is a good demo") Recorded with your words (4f7b10f1). This is the first time the stored state has been read by the person it was stored for, and that is the checkpoint the last three days were missing.

㊟ ("I haven't pressed enter") The half you have seen is the reading; the half not yet seen is whether an agent given that text behaves as if it had been in the conversation. When you do press enter, ask claude-19 something a previous seat already settled, say which of the two clock sources holds a seat's mission, or what was decided about session end. Its answer, right or wrong, is the first real data point, and the brief it saw is recorded under its timestamp so the two can be compared later.

㊢ (state) Nothing in flight, no dispatches pending. Two things remain in your hands when you want them: the yes-or-no list on the proposed move labels, and whether the brief should treat your "ok", "yes" and "go" as answering the agent's last ask, which is the one change I would make next if the list reads as a backlog.
